title: Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael
attributionNote: The Sefaria catalogue records this as a composite or traditionally transmitted work. Authorship is not asserted here beyond the source's own metadata.
description: An early third-century midrashic collection from the land of Israel from the school of Rabbi Yishmael.  Complete Midrash text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Midrash is a family of rabbinic works that interpret scripture through legal exposition, narrative expansion and homily. The genre spans several centuries and several distinct collections.
availabilityNote: Imported from Sefaria. Version, source and licence are recorded per edition.
